claims.claim_text: Cloudflare Research 推出 Meerkat，用 QuePaxa 共識演算法管理橫跨 330 多個資料中心的控制平面狀態
claims.evidence: Meerkat uses the QuePaxa consensus algorithm; serves Cloudflare's 330+ global data centers.

claims.claim_text: 跟 Raft 最大的不同是它不依賴固定 leader——所有副本隨時都能發起寫入
claims.evidence: Source: 'There is a leader, but it is not required — its only advantage is that it can drive consensus with fewer round trips (one) than other replicas (3+).' 'all replicas can perform writes at all times'. Lede corrected from '它沒有 leader' to '不依賴固定 leader' to match leader-optional design.

claims.claim_text: 團隊直言他們「在共識驅動的系統裡遇過多次因 leader 不可用造成的事故」
claims.evidence: We have experienced multiple incidents caused by unavailable leaders in consensus-driven systems.

claims.claim_text: 把 prefill-heavy 工作負載做到最高 4.7 倍加速、decode-heavy 3.1 倍
claims.evidence: improve inference performance by approximately 3.1x for Decode-heavy and by approximately 4.7x for Prefill-heavy workloads (512 Concurrency tier).

claims.claim_text: 放棄傳統 8-way tensor parallelism，改用注意力層資料平行加上 MoE 層 expert parallelism，解掉原本把並行度卡在約 200 requests 的記憶體冗餘
claims.evidence: 8-way Attention Batch Sharding (DP=8) combined with 8-way Expert Parallelism (EP=8); TP=8 forces fractional head sharding, physically impossible; limiting the system to roughly ~200 concurrent requests instead of the planned 512.

claims.claim_text: Meta 升級到 Linux 6.9 後，新的 EEVDF 排程器讓廣告服務出現延遲回退，逼得部分伺服器卡在舊的 6.4 kernel
claims.evidence: upgrading our fleet to Linux (kernel v6.9) we observed that the new EEVDF scheduler was causing a latency regression; a subset of ads hosts were forced to remain on the older v6.4 kernel.

claims.claim_text: 首發就讓廣告檢索階段 p99 延遲降 28%、全機隊省下 3.28 百萬瓦電力
claims.evidence: 28% reduction in service p99 latency on the ads retrieval path; 3.28 megawatts of power savings across the fleet.

claims.claim_text: 後續兩次 user-space 策略更新「以天為單位而非月」再砍 60% p99
claims.evidence: Each follow-on iteration shipped in days rather than months because the scheduler policy lives in user space as a BPF program; Additional 60% reduction in service p99 latency.

claims.claim_text: 作者實測有 16.6% 的分支誤預測 ... Rust 實作從 45,981 微秒降到 7,106 微秒，快了 6.5 倍
claims.evidence: Classic 16.6% branch misprediction; 45,981.1 µs -> 7,106.3 µs (ratio ~6.47x, rounds to 6.5x); branchless 0.0% mispredictions.

claims.claim_text: 作者一句話總結：「分支誤預測完全消失了。」
claims.evidence: Branch mispredictions are completely gone. (branchless table shows 0.0%).

claims.claim_text: 加了看似多餘的 if (j != next_j[i][j])，合成測試中迴圈從 320 微秒降到 80 微秒、快了四倍（真實情境約兩倍）
claims.evidence: this change has sped up the loop from 320 us to 80 us; real-world: I only witnessed a 2x increase.

claims.claim_text: 兩者中位數只差 0.14 ms（4.79 對 4.93 ms）... 真正該避開的是多付 3.13 ms 的 XWayland；VRR 則是降延遲最有感的開關
claims.evidence: X11 4.79 ms vs Wayland 4.93 ms; XWayland adds 3.13 ms of latency; VRR has the biggest impact across the pairings.

claims.claim_text: 這則新聞同時出現在 Hacker News 與 Lobsters。
claims.evidence: The item's own source (the author's blog) says nothing about aggregator presence; the cross-source-cluster fact (HN+Lobsters) is curation metadata, not an article claim. Sentence deleted from the lede.

claims.claim_text: TypeScript 7 正式發布，最大的改變是把編譯器改用 Go 重寫，編譯速度相較 TS6「都是變快很多」、記憶體用量也有下降
claims.evidence: Go rewrite of tsc; '都是變快很多'; memory '整體看起來是有下降'.

claims.claim_text: gslin 提到這次 benchmark 的對照組換過，只留下 VS Code 與 Playwright 這類大型專案
claims.evidence: Source: '比較的對象換掉了，只有 VS Code 與 Playwright 保留下來'. Lede corrected from 'the group was changed TO VS Code and Playwright' to '對照組換過，只留下 VS Code 與 Playwright' to match the retained-not-added semantics.

claims.claim_text: Chromium 148 把 V8 的數學函式從內建 fdlibm 改為呼叫系統 libm ... 約 1/4 的輸入會有 1 ULP 差異 ... 影響 Chrome 148 到 150
claims.evidence: Chromium 148 換掉 tanh 的 fdlibm 改呼叫系統函式; disagree on about a quarter of all inputs, usually by 1 ULP; Chrome 148, 149, and 150.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 把 Copilot code review 換成共用的 Unix 風格工具（grep、glob、view）後，效果一開始反而變差 ... 重寫工具說明 ... 把平均審查成本降了約 20%
claims.evidence: swapped in shared tools grep, glob, view; agent browsing a repository instead of investigating a pull request, increasing cost; result: roughly 20% lower average review cost while maintaining quality.

claims.claim_text: 系統其實得在平行啟動、優先新的、等待、優先舊的這四種語意之間做選擇 ... 沒有上限的佇列可以悄悄堆到十萬筆 ... 這些語意用基本原語湊不出來
claims.evidence: Parallel Spawn / Prefer New / Wait / Prefer Old; queue position as 100K+; If the Prefer Old semantics are not offered, you can't really emulate them using the two primitives.
